build: The look and controls, stage A: the map's look. A crop takes the colour of its group; the farm photo keeps its colour; a bed being picked is a deeper shade; free ground stands out while a crop is carried; the legend is the key to the colours. No date, count, yield or price is touched: tests/look_a_test.cjs proves engine.js and library.js are the build before's except in cropColor, colorGroup and the colour groups.
